b06c728f385e31bb2480fc518074fb47e47d4290.summary: This SecurityScorecard research page analyses the REvil/Sodinokibi ransomware. It says the ransomware has been active since 2019, with breaks due to law enforcement. It describes an RC4 encrypted configuration, killing of targeted processes, stopping of specified services, deletion of Volume Shadow Copies using WMI, and targeting of logical drives and network shares.
